notices: Published prerelease: https://github.com/Cork-Technology/cork-periphery/releases/tag/v0.3.0-rc.1. Public source commit and annotated tag are engineer-signed and GitHub-verified. The release covers source/source archives, not deployment certification; this record separately verifies the combined CorkForSelfAdapter deployment. The two narrow source adapters are not claimed as deployed or required by this Distribution.

The application binary interface (ABI) is derived from a fresh exact-public-tag build using Foundry 1.7.1, Solidity 0.8.30, optimizer runs 200, Cancun Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), bytecodeHash=none and appendCBOR=false. All existing function entries are identical to 0.2.0-rc.1; five functions are added, including rolloverForSelf and rolloverForSelfWithMarket. Constructor inputs expand from three addresses to six.

Whole-runtime equality against the public build was verified at finalized Base block 52946479 (0xbcbf234369a8f0ee09e4a19d6e5deb6cda8b8318e2a986b9af77347a2ab21e93) and Arbitrum block 517262423 (0x40c4aa4a83c5f39fcdaa6fe5bca66f8317ebf97e7b6ff7cc424996f4549c4de6). All 58 source-resolved immutable slots were substituted with the six verified getter values; zero bytes were masked and no metadata was stripped. Both mined factory creation inputs equal the public creation bytecode plus the six constructor addresses after the salt.

Live creation receipts are successful and canonical: Base transaction 0x624ba5e3b790c19d722cb685f73ecc92f84bc84b1aa253b6c43dca7e83b728f4 at block 52942340; Arbitrum transaction 0xac08cf66c5443f9121338a951d051b6c482e6e74ffabf5d94b2395a03aad6bf2 at block 517230925.

The six immutable getters bind to the Phoenix pool-manager and whitelist-manager proxies, the external limit-order protocol, Rollover ExactSettler and PartialSettler, and Market Registry CorkMarketCreator already pinned by the Distribution. This is a direct, immutable adapter with no proxy or governance handoff.

Exact-public-commit hosted CI passed all three jobs: https://github.com/Cork-Technology/cork-periphery/actions/runs/39790003072. The release reports local genuine rollover protocol tests and both rollover smoke paths; those tests are not bundled or executed by public CI, and were not rerun for this record.

Active records deployed runtime only, not consumer activation, holder authorization or production support. The earlier adapter remains deployed; no old approvals, positions or signed orders are migrated or cancelled.
knownIssues: CorkForSelfAdapter has no version() getter. Null records that absence; release identity is the public tag and verified runtime, not an inferred onchain version.

Source/constructor/receipt correspondence is not holder-authorized rollover or market-creation/fill execution, whole-set integration, recovery acceptance or independent security review. Review level remains unreviewed.

The component Release discloses incomplete non-author review, public-portable genuine protocol verification and full deployer-address deny-list checks. The release owner targets resolution by 2026-10-29 and before another release candidate or stable release. Source-release acceptance is not an inherited Distribution waiver.
Existing callers must explicitly select the new adapter and arrange applicable whitelist, token and signed-order permissions; deployment does not activate consumers or retire the prior adapter.
